scenarios.name: AI Grounding / IQ
scenarios.tagline: Give people useful answers from sources they are allowed to see.
scenarios.customer_outcome: A team can answer one useful set of questions from approved sources, enforce access rules, and show why the answers should be trusted.
decision_prompts: Which user decision or action will trusted context improve?
What access boundary, source owner, and system of record apply?
Should the experience lead with Copilot Studio + SharePoint, Foundry IQ, Fabric IQ, Work IQ, or Web IQ?
What golden dataset and operating evidence will prove the pilot is safe and useful?
Where will users meet the assistant, and who operates it once they do?

lessons.title: Confirm scope and connect the grounding foundation
Select the source and permission architecture
Build retrieval before adding an agent
Add agent and live-data routing only when justified
Deploy and surface it to users

build_modules.title: Confirm scope and connect the grounding foundation
build_modules.summary: Confirm the source/platform path before provisioning. Reuse approved tenant resources and verify runtime access.
build_modules.outcome: Approved platform path and working environment connections

build_modules.title: Select the source and permission architecture
build_modules.summary: Choose where approved information lives and which identity is checked when someone asks a question.
build_modules.outcome: Signed source, access, freshness, and system-of-record decision

build_modules.title: Ingest and index approved content
build_modules.summary: Connect the customer's approved source, keep version metadata and access controls, and prove refresh works.
build_modules.outcome: Approved documents are discoverable with source metadata

build_modules.title: Compare chat and embedding choices
build_modules.summary: Compare supported deployments on the answer quality the pilot needs, then check latency, cost, and regional capacity.
build_modules.outcome: A model choice backed by the customer's reviewed questions

build_modules.title: Build retrieval before adding an agent
build_modules.summary: Implement citations, abstention, access-denied behavior, and source freshness before deciding whether Foundry IQ or an agent adds value.
build_modules.outcome: Cited answers and correct refusals from approved sources

build_modules.title: Add agent and live-data routing only when justified
build_modules.summary: Create an agent with explicit source-routing rules and add a verified live-data tool only for a real-time requirement.
build_modules.outcome: Policy and live-data questions route to the correct source

build_modules.title: Evaluate and trace
build_modules.summary: Test citations, access rules, prompt injection, and stale sources. Trace one request from question to answer to explain a failure.
build_modules.outcome: Evaluation gate passed with trace and red-team evidence

build_modules.title: Deploy and surface it to users
build_modules.summary: Choose where people will use the agent, pin the version, and verify anonymous, authorized, and restricted calls through that deployed HTTP surface.
build_modules.outcome: Deployed surface passes anonymous, authorized, and restricted HTTP checks

scenarios.name: Content Understanding and Document Workflow
scenarios.tagline: Turn documents into structured results that a person can review.
scenarios.customer_outcome: A team processes approved documents in its tenant, reviews uncertain fields, and sends the agreed result with evidence of any downstream action.
decision_prompts: Which document decision creates measurable value when it becomes faster and more consistent?
Are representative, authorized samples and expected outcomes ready for SME testing?
Where must human review, correction, and evidence be retained in the workflow?
What isolation, access, and promotion controls are required beyond Studio project/analyzer boundaries?

lessons.title: Confirm scope and connect the document foundation

build_modules.title: Confirm scope and connect the document foundation
build_modules.summary: Agree the document class and intended action before selecting services. Reuse the approved environment and connect the required runtime identities.
build_modules.outcome: Document-processing resources and a usable environment contract

build_modules.title: Connect an approved document source
build_modules.summary: Choose Azure Blob, ADLS Gen2, SharePoint, or OneLake and preserve source identity, version, permissions, and quarantine controls.
build_modules.outcome: A working source adapter with authorized intake and rejection evidence

build_modules.title: Select the extraction capability
build_modules.summary: Test extraction options against real sample quality and the fields reviewers need. Then check region and cost.
build_modules.outcome: Document capability and implementation decision

build_modules.title: Implement typed extraction with evidence
build_modules.summary: Return a validated result with confidence, page references, missing-field handling, and no inferred values.
build_modules.outcome: Structured extraction result and low-confidence failure path

build_modules.title: Build review, correction, and handoff
build_modules.summary: Connect the customer review surface and the agreed result handoff. Retain corrections and prove approved posting cannot duplicate an action.
build_modules.outcome: A completed review with its authorized handoff or destination receipt

build_modules.title: Evaluate and trace the workflow
build_modules.summary: Measure field accuracy and false approvals across representative documents. Track how often people must review a result and how long the workflow takes.
build_modules.outcome: Scenario evaluation gate and trace review

build_modules.title: Deploy the reviewable workflow
build_modules.summary: Ship the approved workflow behind an authenticated endpoint with managed identity, application monitoring, and a rollback path.
build_modules.outcome: Controlled pilot deployment

scenarios.name: Avatar Scenario
scenarios.tagline: Build an interactive assistant or a repeatable content-production application.
scenarios.customer_outcome: Users get grounded help, or content owners run a repeatable media workflow, with accessible output and controlled release in their tenant.
decision_prompts: Are we building an interactive assistant or a repeatable content-production application, and what proves that application works?
Which communication, learning, or support moment should the pilot serve first, and for which audience, locale, and channel?
Which media format serves that application goal, and does an avatar add value over audio or text?
Which approved sources and named owners may support the script, and when do they expire?
Who must approve factual accuracy, legal/compliance, brand, and accessibility before anything is published?
How will the experience disclose synthetic/AI assistance and offer human help without deceptive representation?
Which evaluation, red-team, and operational measures decide whether to iterate, scale, pause, or withdraw?

lessons.title: Choose the application your users need
Add grounded authoring or live answers when needed
Prove and operate the delivered experience

build_modules.title: Choose the application your users need
build_modules.summary: Choose interactive assistance or repeatable content production before selecting a media format. Agree application acceptance checks and prove feasibility.
build_modules.outcome: An agreed application goal, with a user task or workflow trigger and delivery owners

build_modules.title: Connect the required foundation
build_modules.summary: Reuse approved tenant resources and verify runtime access. Add models or indexed retrieval only when the chosen experience needs them.
build_modules.outcome: Foundry and Speech resources with a usable environment contract

build_modules.title: Connect content and approve wording
build_modules.summary: Connect authoritative content and keep its version and expiry. For content production, detect source changes and approve replacement wording before rendering.
build_modules.outcome: Approved wording bound to authoritative source revisions

build_modules.title: Add grounded authoring or live answers when needed
build_modules.summary: Skip generation when wording is already approved. Otherwise connect the approved sources and prove citations, refusal, and support routing.
build_modules.outcome: Approved-claim answers with citations and a refusal path

build_modules.title: Connect generation to the application
build_modules.summary: Connect generation jobs to the content workflow or live rendering to the assistant client. Include accessible alternatives and recover failed jobs without duplicate output.
build_modules.outcome: A working generation path in the application, with accessible output

build_modules.title: Approve publication and prove withdrawal
build_modules.summary: Use the customer's approval system to authorize the exact media revision. Prove publication and withdrawal in the actual user channel.
build_modules.outcome: Authorized publication and tested withdrawal from the serving channel

build_modules.title: Evaluate, red-team, trace, and operate
build_modules.summary: Prove the assistant through its authenticated client or a complete source-update cycle through the deployed content workflow. Test failure recovery and withdrawal before release.
build_modules.outcome: Application acceptance evidence with an operating owner; a generated video alone is insufficient

scenarios.name: Operational Agents
scenarios.tagline: Carry out bounded work with approved tools and evidence of the result.
scenarios.customer_outcome: A team can control an agent's tool execution, approve exact changes, and recover interrupted work without repeating effects blindly.
decision_prompts: Which task is bounded enough to delegate, and when must the agent stop?
Which live facts and tool permissions does the task need?
Where does task state belong, and what must survive a restart?
Who approves an exact change, and how will the system reject stale approval?
How will an operator determine whether an interrupted operation committed?

lessons.title: Choose and verify the execution foundation
Prove behavior and prepare to operate

build_modules.title: Define scope and refusal
build_modules.summary: Bind a task to explicit record IDs and reject requests outside that scope.
build_modules.outcome: An out-of-scope request fails without changing a record.

build_modules.title: Connect the execution environment
build_modules.summary: Connect the customer's runtime to an approved model and tool API. Use local checks only for reference behavior.
build_modules.outcome: The runtime can authenticate to the required services and rejects denied access.

build_modules.title: Connect narrow tool operations
build_modules.summary: Implement the customer's read and proposal adapters with destination authorization and version checks.
build_modules.outcome: The connected operation rejects invalid arguments and duplicate-operation conflicts.

build_modules.title: Persist task progress
build_modules.summary: Keep task progress in the customer's durable application store, separate from live records.
build_modules.outcome: Pending approval and prior evidence survive a runtime restart.

build_modules.title: Enforce execution limits
build_modules.summary: Apply persisted call and time budgets around the shared execution loop.
build_modules.outcome: Exhausted work stops instead of receiving a fresh budget on resume.

build_modules.title: Bind approval to a proposal
build_modules.summary: Require a separate operator decision tied to the task, exact arguments, and expected record version.
build_modules.outcome: Only an unchanged approved proposal can reach the write boundary.

build_modules.title: Reconcile interrupted operations
build_modules.summary: Interrupt the process around a tool commit and look up the operation before deciding what happened.
build_modules.outcome: A committed operation is recovered once; an unproven result stays unresolved.

build_modules.title: Deliver and hand over the connected task
build_modules.summary: Test through the customer's user channel, inspect destination evidence, and rehearse recovery with the operating owner.
build_modules.outcome: A deployed scoped task with customer acceptance evidence and an operating owner.
